answer: A work-slot bond stops mass fakes at the wharf: one slot each, 70 locked. Per epoch the holder runs one juniper-kernel crate through it. The holder files a key-signed kernel count on the manifest. Auditors recount 1 in 8 crates. A miss over 3% or reused serial burns the deposit. First 34, kth 34+6(k-1). 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000. A rented-slot ring fails: the manifest names the owner. Honest workers pay 34 once.
